purpose: Version Prompt Kit semantic capabilities per prompt as governed history, making silent weakening, disappearance, transfer, or crowding mechanically detectable. The capability matrix is a deterministic derived projection; profiles and migrations are the tracked authority.

ownership_boundaries.P79: Identity, admission, prior-art, similarity/overlap, family/cluster, and strengthen-before-add. Remains the gate for ADD/RETIRE; calls semantic coverage validator for coverage/overlap simulation before ID allocation or removal.
ownership_boundaries.P13: Recurring-process hardening. Consumes semantic-coverage violations as defect incidents when the same PSC rule recurs and must strengthen the shared prevention owner.
ownership_boundaries.P94: Retained regression interpretation. Preserves the negative/positive fixture corpus for semantic-coverage rules and registers the focused semantic regression in the deterministic floor.
ownership_boundaries.PromptStrength: Global shared execution-strength floor. Supplies inherited/shared capability obligations (canonical_identity, fresh_evidence_floor, etc.) and remains the seed vocabulary for shared capabilities; does not become the full catalog and does not own per-prompt PRIMARY assignment.
ownership_boundaries.QualityHistory: Canonical text/source lineage. Proves prompt-body blobs are immutable unless a semantic migration chains them; protects every canonical prompt source including docs/prompts.json; body-changing capability migrations must cross-link to this ledger.
ownership_boundaries.Topology: Prompt identity, similarity, overlap, family, and prompt-to-prompt relations. Owns CO_USAGE/TRANSITION/SUBSTITUTION/COMPLEMENT as the only prompt-to-prompt relation vocabulary; semantic coverage may derive or validate those edges but must not introduce competing synonyms.
ownership_boundaries.RuntimeCompliance: Observed model/config/runtime evidence. Downstream calibration only; may select high-value PRIMARY/REQUIRED capabilities for live proof but cannot rewrite accepted profile history automatically.

presence.description: Strength of capability provision. REQUIRED is the protected non-weakening threshold; SUPPORT and AWARE are weaker informative levels; NONE is absent.

ownership.description: Claim of canonical ownership. PRIMARY is the protected non-weakening owner that may only move via explicit TRANSFER or intentional RETIRE with coverage proof.

capability_relation.description: How this prompt relates to the capability. IMPLEMENTS provides the behavior; ROUTES_TO delegates to another prompt; TESTS validates; GUARDS enforces forbidding; FORBIDDEN explicitly disallows. This is not a new prompt-to-prompt topology edge.

delivery_source.description: Provenance of the behavior. CANONICAL_BODY is direct prompt text; SHARED_POLICY is inherited from a shared contract; COMPILER_OVERLAY from prompt compilation; ROUTED_OWNER via another prompt; TEST_GUARD via focused test.

evidence_refs.description: One or more repository-owned proof references for every material PRIMARY/REQUIRED assignment. Must resolve to a tracked test, contract, or ontology-evidence receipt. Preference, critique, or candidate inference alone is not proof.

rationale.description: Short bounded explanation for PRIMARY/REQUIRED/FORBIDDEN assignments, referencing why this prompt owns or forbids the capability.

display_projection.rule: PRIMARY when ownership is PRIMARY; else REQUIRED when presence is REQUIRED; else SUPPORT when presence is SUPPORT; else AWARE when presence is AWARE; else NONE. PRIMARY and REQUIRED are not ordinal; the projection preserves both dimensions.

direct_vs_inherited.description: Shared-policy/compiler behavior must not be falsely credited as direct ownership on every prompt.
direct_vs_inherited.direct: Assignment owned by the prompt's own profile entry; stored per prompt; versioned by the prompt's canonical_sha256.
direct_vs_inherited.inherited: Assignment referenced through a versioned inherited_source record (shared policy or compiler overlay identity + revision). The derived matrix expands inherited sources so every prompt still shows a complete cell, but PRIMARY remains with the canonical direct owner.

fingerprint.direct: Canonical prompt record hash (canonical_sha256) plus profile_version and profile_sha256.
fingerprint.inherited: Inherited source identity/revision (e.g., actionable-next-step-policy.v1.json@sha, compiler overlay revision) recorded in the profile's inherited_sources array; a revision change invalidates dependent derived cells without implying each prompt body changed.

direct_vs_inherited.rule: PRIMARY ownership normally remains with the direct owner even when many prompts inherit REQUIRED behavior from a shared source.

prompt_to_prompt_relations.rule: Reuse executable Prompt Topology reserved channels. A semantic-coverage implementation may derive or validate those channels from accepted profiles but must not introduce competing synonyms for the same prompt-to-prompt concepts.

ontology_reuse.chain: capability -> skill -> implementation/prompt -> invocation/run -> evidence -> proof ceiling
ontology_reuse.rule: Profile evidence references should reuse the existing ontology evidence chain rather than creating a second runtime/evidence-history store. Static proof may reference focused tests/contracts; runtime proof should reference ontology-evidence receipts when available.

lifecycle_kinds.description: New prompt identity with a candidate semantic profile, distinct residual proof, topology overlap simulation, and capability coverage simulation before allocation.
Existing prompt gains capability presence or ownership (e.g., SUPPORT→REQUIRED, SECONDARY→PRIMARY) with evidence and without weakening any protected prior.
Body text changed but no semantic capability delta; requires focused proof that protected PRIMARY/REQUIRED assignments still validate and a matching Prompt Quality History source migration.
Deliberate semantic change that weakens, removes, or redefines a previously protected capability with explicit rationale and coverage proof; not a silent downgrade.
PRIMARY or REQUIRED responsibility moves from one prompt to an equal-or-stronger canonical owner with proof; source prompt may weaken only after successor coverage is proven.
Prompt identity removed; requires global coverage simulation proving no protected capability loses its last owner; writes a tombstone profile and retains history forever; P-number never reused.
Previously RETIRED prompt identity reactivated; requires new distinct residual and coverage proof; appends to append-only history without erasing the prior retirement.

psc_rules.title: PROFILE_COVERAGE_COMPLETE
psc_rules.description: Every current canonical prompt has exactly one ACCEPTED profile before strict semantic enforcement may activate. No prompt may be uncovered.
psc_rules.enforcement: FAIL when profile count != canonical prompt count or any prompt lacks ACCEPTED profile; blocks strict gate activation.

psc_rules.title: PROFILE_BINDS_CANONICAL_PROMPT
psc_rules.description: An ACCEPTED profile binds to the exact prompt identity and canonical record hash (canonical_sha256).
psc_rules.enforcement: FAIL when profile prompt_id or canonical_sha256 does not match the current topology canonical record.

psc_rules.title: KNOWN_CAPABILITY_ONLY
psc_rules.description: Every assignment references a capability_id that exists in the stable catalog.
psc_rules.enforcement: FAIL when capability_id is unknown or alias is used without resolving to canonical ID.

psc_rules.title: REQUIRED_PRESENCE_NON_WEAKENING
psc_rules.description: A previously accepted REQUIRED presence may not fall to SUPPORT, AWARE, or NONE without an explicit ACCEPTED migration.
psc_rules.enforcement: FAIL when candidate presence < REQUIRED for a previously REQUIRED cell and no ACCEPTED migration authorizes the downgrade.

psc_rules.title: PRIMARY_OWNERSHIP_NON_WEAKENING
psc_rules.description: A previously accepted PRIMARY ownership may not fall to SECONDARY or NONE unless responsibility is explicitly transferred or intentionally retired with coverage proof.
psc_rules.enforcement: FAIL when candidate ownership < PRIMARY for a previously PRIMARY cell without an ACCEPTED TRANSFER or RETIRE migration that proves alternative coverage.

psc_rules.title: TRANSFER_EQUAL_OR_STRONGER
psc_rules.description: A transfer is accepted only when successor coverage is equal-or-stronger for the protected capability and required proof exists.
psc_rules.enforcement: PASS only when successor's presence >= source's former presence and ownership >= source's former ownership for the transferred capability, with evidence refs and focused proof.

psc_rules.title: RETIRE_NO_COVERAGE_HOLE
psc_rules.description: Retirement fails if it produces an uncovered previously protected capability.
psc_rules.enforcement: FAIL when global coverage simulation after removal shows AT_LEAST_ONE_PRIMARY or AT_LEAST_ONE_REQUIRED_OR_PRIMARY policy violated for any previously protected capability.

psc_rules.title: ADD_REQUIRES_DISTINCT_RESIDUAL
psc_rules.description: P79 cannot ADD when topology/profile overlap shows an existing owner can absorb the use case without a reviewed distinct residual.
psc_rules.enforcement: FAIL when candidate profile's overlap with nearest PRIMARY owner exceeds STRENGTHEN threshold without a distinct residual review.

psc_rules.title: BODY_CHANGE_REQUIRES_PROFILE_DISPOSITION
psc_rules.description: Any changed canonical prompt body must have a capability migration or an exact NO_CAPABILITY_CHANGE attestation bound to focused proof.
psc_rules.enforcement: FAIL when canonical_sha256 changed but no ACCEPTED migration for that prompt exists, or NO_CAPABILITY_CHANGE lacks matching source-history migration and proof.

psc_rules.title: SAME_AGENT_RESCORING_CANNOT_RESET_PRIOR
psc_rules.description: Generated or proposed candidate profiles cannot replace accepted history. The prior remains the regression truth.
psc_rules.enforcement: FAIL when a candidate inference attempts to overwrite an ACCEPTED profile without going through the migration chain.

psc_rules.title: NEW_PRIMARY_OR_REQUIRED_REQUIRES_PROOF
psc_rules.description: A new PRIMARY or REQUIRED claim requires evidence, not just a higher self-assigned rating.
psc_rules.enforcement: FAIL when a new PRIMARY/REQUIRED assignment lacks valid evidence_refs or focused test proof.

psc_rules.title: GLOBAL_PRIMARY_CROWDING_REVIEW
psc_rules.description: Unexpected multiple PRIMARY owners for the same capability trigger configured crowding policy.
psc_rules.enforcement: WARN or FAIL per catalog overlap_policy (OVERLAP_EXPECTED, OVERLAP_ALLOWED_WITH_RATIONALE, PRIMARY_CROWDING_WARNING, PRIMARY_CROWDING_FAIL).

psc_rules.title: SOURCE_HISTORY_COMPLETE
psc_rules.description: Every canonical prompt-body source, including docs/prompts.json, is covered by Prompt Quality History.
psc_rules.enforcement: FAIL when canonical_body_sources set != builder-derived complete source set; enforced by validate_prompt_quality_history.py audit_canonical_source_coverage.

psc_rules.title: LIFECYCLE_TRANSITION_ATOMIC
psc_rules.description: ADD, STRENGTHEN, RETIRE and other lifecycle transitions cannot leave registry, profile, migration, generated site, or required semantic proof mutually inconsistent.
psc_rules.enforcement: FAIL when any of registry/profile/migration/site/proof are not updated atomically to the same revision head.

psc_rules.title: SOURCE_AND_CAPABILITY_MIGRATION_LINK
psc_rules.description: Every body-changing capability migration must reference the matching Prompt Quality History semantic migration and agree on prompt IDs and source hashes/affected IDs.
psc_rules.enforcement: FAIL when capability migration for a body change lacks a corresponding source-history migration or hashes/IDs diverge.

psc_rules.title: INHERITED_SOURCE_INTEGRITY
psc_rules.description: Shared policy/compiler capability inheritance is versioned by source identity/revision; dependent matrix cells cannot remain accepted against a changed inherited source without revalidation.
psc_rules.enforcement: FAIL when an inherited source revision changes but dependent profiles still claim the old fingerprint as accepted; requires revalidation of derived cells.

derived_artifacts.rule: Matrix and reports are deterministic reconstructions from ACCEPTED profiles and the catalog; they are never edited directly and are never the source of truth for profile acceptance.

candidate_inference.rule: A proposal generator or LLM may suggest PROVISIONAL profiles, but may never overwrite an ACCEPTED profile. Candidate inference is evidence input only.

proof_ceiling: Repository contract and static semantic history only. This contract can prove that declared prompt semantics are versioned, non-weakening, and lifecycle-governed against tracked profiles/migrations. It does not prove downstream model obedience, live execution, hosted CI availability, browser/device behavior, deployment, or operator acceptance. Runtime calibration remains downstream evidence via Runtime Compliance.
